OkHttp 4.12.0 public suffix data

The public suffix data used by OkHttp is covered by the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
Its exact upstream source distribution can be obtained, without charge, from:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/squareup/okhttp3/okhttp/4.12.0/okhttp-4.12.0-sources.jar
Resource: okhttp3/internal/publicsuffix/publicsuffixes.gz

The same data, decoded into editable UTF-8 rule and exception lists, is included
in this repository under third-party/maven/okhttp-publicsuffix-source/.
The accompanying MPL-2.0 text and upstream NOTICE apply to those data files.
The rest of FolderSpan remains under its respective licenses.
